meta.name: learn-codebase
meta.description: Prime a codebase by reading every source file in full. Use when starting work on a new or unfamiliar project, or when the user asks to "learn the codebase", "read the codebase", "prime", or "get up to speed".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速熟悉陌生代码库的完整结构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果刚接手一个不熟悉的项目，需要快速理解代码全貌。
copy.tagline_en: Quickly understand the full structure of an unfamiliar codebase
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just took over an unfamiliar project and need to grasp the codebase quickly.

howto.what: 它会逐个完整读取代码库里的每个源文件,大文件用 Read 工具的 offset 和 limit 参数分页读完,以建立对整个代码库的理解。这个过程会消耗较多 token。
howto.when: 当你在新项目或不熟悉的项目上开始工作时,或你提到“learn the codebase”“read the codebase”等说法、要求熟悉代码库时触发。

say.text: 完整读一遍这个代码库,我要开始改它
say.note: 它会逐个读完所有源文件
逐文件读取并建立理解

say.text: 先学会这个代码库再动手
say.note: 读完全部源文件后才继续

howto.what_en: It reads every source file in full, paging large files with the Read tool's offset and limit parameters, to build a deep understanding of the codebase. This uses a lot of tokens up front.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you start work on a new or unfamiliar project, or when you ask to "learn the codebase", "read the codebase" or "get up to speed".

say_en.text: Read the whole codebase in full, I'm about to change it
Help me get up to speed on this new project
say_en.note: Reads files one by one and builds context

say_en.text: Learn this codebase before you touch anything
say_en.note: Finishes reading all sources, then continues
